title: Collage with Central Figure and Graphic Overlays
coreRelationships: Central figure and polar bear as primary subjects
Diagonal tape overlays creating depth and division
Scattered line-art graphics providing background texture
Monochromatic palette with light blue accents
Contrast between photographic elements and graphic elements
reuseFormula: Recreate the layered collage structure: desaturated central figure with a polar bear, dense white line-art background, and translucent light blue diagonal tape overlays. Integrate varied sans-serif and script typography into both background and tape elements, ensuring high contrast and an urban aesthetic.

figures (e.g., skulls, hearts, barbed wire, small devil figures, lightning bolts). Ensure these graphics vary in size and rotation, creating a dense, textured look. Place a black and white photographic image of a person making a peace sign, partially obscured by a white polar bear, in the mid-ground. The person should be looking towards the viewer. Ensure the overall image is desaturated, primarily black, white, and gray. · On top of the generated image, add several translucent, light blue diagonal bands resembling packing tape. These bands should overlap each other and the main subjects. On these tape bands, add repeating text in a dark red or black condensed sans-serif font, oriented along the diagonal of the tape, mimicking brand labels and short phrases. Also, add scattered white text in a bold, geometric sans-serif and a handwritten script font in various sizes and rotations directly onto the dark background, ensuring they integrate with the doodle texture. · Are all photographic elements desaturated to grayscale? · Are the tape overlays translucent and light blue? · Is the background densely packed with white line-art graphics? · Is there a clear contrast between the main subjects and the background? · Are the text elements varied in style and placement, consistent with the original's chaotic aesthetic? · high
